my_withdrawal_was_correct_in_kind_and_to.lesson: a withdrawal is a claim too. Withdrawing a whole result because part of it is wrong destroys the correct part, and the correct part here was three of four numbers. The right move was to withdraw the ATTRIBUTION and mark the counts UNVERIFIED, which is what the receipt should have said.

correctness_control.STRENGTH_OF_THIS_CHECK_STATED: this is identical GREEDY OUTPUT, not identical LOGITS. argmax absorbs small numerical differences, so 6/6 token agreement rules out a gross semantic change and does NOT establish bit-identity. A logit comparison is the stronger check and was not run here.

fusion_measurement.THE_INERT_LEVER_IS_THE_FINDING: FUSE_MLP is a no-op on the sealed resident, and it is the lever aimed at the LARGEST single kernel family in the graph -- 192 dispatches/token, 25.4% of the fused graph. Every fusion that fired is on a uniform-q4 mixer projection; the one that did not is on the affine-q2 MLP. The obvious reading is that the fused gate+up path exists for the uniform codec and not for the affine one, which would make this a REPRESENTATION-COVERAGE gap rather than a graph limitation. THAT READING IS NOT VERIFIED HERE -- what is measured is that the flag changes nothing, not why.

claim_boundary: ONE artifact, ONE prompt (11 tokens), ONE machine. Dispatch COUNT is a structural property of the graph and is not expected to vary with prompt content, but it was not varied and that is stated rather than assumed.

COUNTS ONLY. Nothing was timed. No dispatch here carries a duration, bytes moved, or FLOPs, so this discharges the COUNT column of the S031 §3 atlas and NOT the time/bytes/FLOPs columns. A count Pareto is not a time Pareto and the most numerous kernel need not be the most expensive -- S031 §3 says so explicitly.

NO TPS MEASURED. 964 -> 756 is a 21.6% dispatch reduction and says NOTHING about wall time; at the measured ~11 us intra-command-buffer dispatch cost the arithmetic ceiling is ~2.3 ms/token, but that is an extrapolation from another regime and is not claimed.
NO CAPABILITY RUN. The 43-case suite was not re-run under fusion. 6/6 greedy token agreement is a smoke check, not the S031 §18 floor of 30/43.
The DeltaNet/GQA layer split (48/16) is read off the dispatch counts, not from the config.
next: time the 756 graph and re-run the 43-case capability suite under fusion, because a dispatch reduction that is not a wall-time win and not capability-preserving is not a win
